# PersonPhoneInput

A phone number as written to a person record. The code fields take single letters here, but they are input codes mapped to the stored model at write time (see PersonPhone): several codes collapse onto one stored value, and reads return the stored words, not the codes.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `phoneNumber` * | string | Non-numeric characters are stripped, then the remaining digits are validated for the country implied by `countryCode`/`dialingPrefix`, defaulting to the context's country. A number that fails validation returns 400 INVALID_PARAMETER "Phone number is not valid. If entering UK number, please include leading 0.". e.g. `907-111-2222`, `(907) 111-2222` |
| `phoneType` | string or null | `H` = home, `W` = work, `O` = other, `C` = cell, `M` = main, `F` = fax, `P` = personal. A write-only input code, not what is stored: at write time it is collapsed and stored as `phoneType` `Personal` (H, C, M, P), `Work` (W, F) or `Other` (O), and `C` additionally stores `deviceType: "Cell"` while `F` stores `deviceType: "Fax"`. Reads return the stored values (see PersonPhone). One of: `H`, `W`, `O`, `C`, `M`, `F`, `P`, `None`. |
| `deviceType` | string or integer or null | What kind of device answers the number; decides whether it is textable. Accepts either a letter — `C` = cell, `L` = landline, `U` = unknown, `F` = fax, `V` = VoIP — or the equivalent numeric id: 1 (Cell), 2 (Landline), 4 (Unknown), 5 (Fax), 6 (VoIP). Defaults to Unknown. Available since May 9, 2024. |
| `ext` | string or null | Extension. Over six characters returns 400 INVALID_PARAMETER "'ext' must be between 0 and 6 characters". |
| `isPreferred` | boolean or null | Whether this becomes the person's preferred number. Defaults to false and stays there — a newly added phone never takes the preferred flag implicitly, however many are written. An explicit `true` is honoured. |
| `phoneOptInStatus` | string or null | `I` = opt in, `U` = unknown (the default), `O` = opt out. Reads back as `Opt-In`, `Unknown`, `Opt-Out`, and also sets the read-only `smsOptInStatus` to the same value. One of: `I`, `U`, `O`, `None`. |
| `isCellStatus` | object or object or object or object or null | Confidence that the number reaches a cell phone. Omitting it leaves any existing explicit status unchanged. |
| `dialingPrefix` | string or null | 1 to 3 numeric characters identifying the country, e.g. "1". If sent alongside `countryCode`, the two must name the same country. |
| `countryCode` | string or null | ISO alpha-2 country code, e.g. "US". If sent alongside `dialingPrefix`, the two must name the same country. |

`*` = required.
